name: bento-grid
title: Bento Grid
description: Container-responsive bento grid with cards that lift on hover, move their artwork and follow the pointer with a soft glow.

props.name: columns
props.description: BentoGrid: columns on wide containers. One column below 672px of container width.

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: BentoGrid: minimum height of one grid row, any CSS length.

props.name: title
props.description: BentoCard: heading, also the accessible name of the link or button.

props.name: description
props.description: BentoCard: short copy under the title.

props.name: icon
props.description: BentoCard: small icon above the title.

props.name: visual
props.description: BentoCard: decorative artwork behind the content. Use group-hover/bento: classes inside it to react to hover.

props.name: colSpan
props.description: BentoCard: columns spanned on wide containers, clamped to the grid's column count.

props.name: rowSpan
props.description: BentoCard: rows spanned on wide containers.

props.name: href
props.description: BentoCard: makes the whole card a link.

props.name: onClick
props.description: BentoCard: makes the whole card a button when there is no href.

props.name: cta
props.description: BentoCard: small call to action under the copy, shown on interactive cards only.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the grid or the card.
